title: Ballet Shoes
author: Noel Streatfeild
short_summary: Three unrelated orphan girls — Pauline, Petrova, and Posy Fossil — are all brought home as babies by an eccentric fossil-collector known as Great-Uncle Matthew. Raised by his great-niece Sylvia and their devoted nurse, the three sisters attend a school for dancing and acting, each discovering a very different talent, and vow together to get the family name into the history books.
extended_summary:
Great-Uncle Matthew, an adventurous fossil collector nicknamed GUM, has a habit of bringing home unusual souvenirs from his travels — but his strangest finds are three baby girls, each rescued under different circumstances and given the same last name, Fossil, so they can grow up as sisters. When GUM sets off on another long expedition and doesn't come back for years, it falls to his great-niece Sylvia and their loyal nurse to raise Pauline, Petrova, and Posy on a shrinking budget.

To help make ends meet, the girls enroll at the Children's Academy of Dancing and Stage Training, where their different personalities and talents quickly become clear. Pauline loves acting and dreams of the stage, Posy is a natural, driven dancer, and Petrova would rather be tinkering with engines and airplanes than performing at all. As money grows tighter and each girl works toward her own kind of success, the three sisters lean on each other and their unusual family to keep their shared promise: that the name Fossil will one day be found in a history book, because they made it happen themselves.
